nit, I think we should log if `organizationId` is undefined and then just not increment any rate limit counter rather than falling back to a `default`

```suggestion
  organizationId: string,
```

I don't know if this is necessary but since we're doing `contentArray[0]` later, can we just check for length here to avoid any errors
```suggestion
    if (responseBody?.item?.content && Array.isArray(responseBody.item.content) && responseBody.item.content.length) {
```

rather than default to `0`, we could have the caller handle the nullability so that we dont have the case where we surpass the alert threshold, then get an error when checking queue size and clear the alert/banner even if the actual issue is still ongoing
@tomharmon changed the condition a bit - didn't want to run into issues with undefined
